description: Each maturing sweep fact is published once per sweep (s5-v12, audit mechanism M11, 2026-09-14). The maturation walk re-reads a sweep from its frozen evidence every pass and a fact's key carries the candle, so when a later pass found a different first qualifying candle the same fact was written again (host: 9 s5-v10 pools with two stop hunts, 10 with two displacements). Each mutation removes one half of the guard. Deterministic test, so one battery run is a verdict. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/sweep_facts_publish_once.json

mutations.name: a fact already published for this sweep is written again
the facts earlier passes published are not read back
